definitions.ask: Which key should take over the preview's half-page-up scroll, now that Ctrl-U resets the panel?
definitions.why: Y sits next to U and nothing in Bob Refs uses Ctrl-Y; the Ctrl-U scroll dates from 4c22d09

choices.label: Ctrl-Y scrolls the preview up, next to U; the search field gives up native yank
Ctrl-B scrolls the preview up like vim's page-back; the search field gives up caret-left
Ctrl-U keeps scrolling the preview up; Ctrl-Shift-U resets the panel instead

definitions.ask: Should Esc close Bob Refs at once, keeping the query, filters, selection, and preview scroll?
definitions.why: Capture's Esc keeps its draft; the ladder would wipe the query and selection on every Esc

choices.label: After any card or banner, Esc hides the panel and the next open restores everything
Esc still clears query, Tabs or Newest, then scope first, so an Esc close remembers little

definitions.ask: Should Shift-⌘O (Bob Refs in Tabs) also restore the remembered query, scope, selection, and scroll?
definitions.why: Shift-⌘O is the usual way in from Highlights; a tab switch still restores the preselection

choices.label: Shift-⌘O restores the remembered view with Tabs on; an open remembered row stays selected
Shift-⌘O keeps today's fresh Tabs view: blank query, All, previous tab preselected
